                    gains.append(w + d1[v] - d0[v])

from bisect import bisect_left
class Solution:
    def shortestMatchingSubstring(self, s: str, p: str) -> int:
        parts=p.split('*')
        non=[x for x in parts if x]
        if not non:return 0
        n=len(s)
        def occ(t):
            m=len(t); pi=[0]*m
            j=0
            for i in range(1,m):
                while j and t[i]!=t[j]: j=pi[j-1]
                if t[i]==t[j]: j+=1
                pi[i]=j
            out=[]; j=0
            for i,ch in enumerate(s):
                while j and ch!=t[j]: j=pi[j-1]
                if ch==t[j]: j+=1
                if j==m:
                    out.append(i-m+1); j=pi[j-1]
            return out
        lists=[occ(x) for x in non]
        if any(not x for x in lists): return -1
        ans=n+1
        first=lists[0]; l0=len(non[0])
        for st in first:
            pos=st+l0
            end=pos
            ok=True
            for k in range(1,len(non)):
                q=lists[k]; z=bisect_left(q,pos)
                if z==len(q): ok=False; break
                end=q[z]+len(non[k]); pos=end
            if ok and end-st<ans: ans=end-st
        return -1 if ans==n+1 else ans
